Bug_Title: "wait" should not be called when multiple locks are held
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the generated code by having threadA acquire locks on both mon1 and mon2 before calling wait() on mon2. This causes threadA to release only the lock on mon2 while still holding the lock on mon1, preventing threadB from acquiring both locks and thus causing a deadlock.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case calls the showBug method, which triggers the bug by having threadA acquire locks on both mon1 and mon2 before calling wait() on mon2. This causes threadA to release only the lock on mon2 while still holding the lock on mon1, preventing threadB from acquiring both locks and thus causing a deadlock.
